scope: Public distribution of legacy manual image references

local_only_images.reason: Adobe Illustrator screenshot containing a rock photograph; applicable reproduction permissions have not been established.
local_only_images.treatment: Retain an unchanged local documentary copy; exclude it from the public Git tree. Preserve its entry in the historical extraction manifest.

integrity: A local-only image may be absent from a public checkout. If present locally, its hash must still match the historical manifest. Other reference images remain required.
history: This policy does not rewrite existing repository history or remove files already tracked by Git. The maintainer must untrack the listed file and commit that removal.
